rungs.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
rungs.summary: Builds small features across the browser, the server and the database, with review.
rungs.knowledge: Knows HTML, CSS, JavaScript and one server language well enough to follow a feature from click to database row.
rungs.delivery: Delivers small, well-scoped tasks that touch both ends, with a senior checking the design.
rungs.leadership: Asks for help early, explains what they changed and why, and keeps tickets up to date.

rungs.title: Full Stack Developer
rungs.summary: Owns features end to end: interface, API, data and release.
rungs.knowledge: Works fluently in the company's front-end and back-end stack, understands the product being built and who it is for.
rungs.delivery: Delivers whole features independently: designs the API and schema, writes tests, ships and watches them in production.
rungs.leadership: Reviews teammates' code, explains trade-offs to non-engineers and picks up support issues on what they built.

rungs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
rungs.summary: Designs systems that span the stack and raises the standard of the team.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in at least one side of the stack and sound on the other; chooses data stores, caching and delivery patterns on evidence.
rungs.delivery: Designs and delivers multi-service features, owns their reliability and security, and reduces risk before it ships.
rungs.leadership: Mentors, leads technical discussions with product and design, and represents engineering in client or customer conversations.

rungs.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
rungs.summary: Leads a squad across the stack and answers for what it ships.
rungs.knowledge: Sets the technical direction of a product area; connects architecture, cost, security and the product roadmap.
rungs.delivery: Plans and delivers a quarter of work for a squad, balancing features, debt and operations.
rungs.leadership: Grows the people in the squad, resolves disagreements and talks to clients, product and leadership with equal ease.

rungs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
rungs.summary: Shapes how the whole organisation builds products across the stack.
rungs.knowledge: Recognised expert across the stack and its trade-offs; sets standards others adopt and judges new technology (including AI) on evidence.
rungs.delivery: Solves the hardest cross-cutting problems, de-risks major migrations and designs systems that other teams build on.
rungs.leadership: Influences without authority, advises leadership on technology bets and develops the next generation of leads.
